name: Life of Guy
source:
Life of Guy is a sandbox adult visual novel that aims to be different from many of the other titles from this genre.

The game takes place in a fictional world where regular humans and supernatural entities (known as Specials) live side by side albeit with obvious frictions due to their innate differences. 

The main story centers around Guy who has been possessed by a Lust Goddess. He must now navigate his new cursed life and befriend many supernatural characters in an effort to learn how to rid himself of his demonic passenger and return to his normal life.
